name: @tetherto/mdk-plugin-mvp-site
description: MVP-site example plugin: aggregates the site (miners, a powermeter, a mining pool) via the MDK protocol client over the RPC listener.

routes.description: Live site snapshot assembled from `telemetry.pull` across all workers: all miners, site power consumption from powermeters, and pool data from all minerpool workers. Workers that are down are listed in `unavailableWorkers` with their device counts, since their devices cannot be read.

routes.description: Historical telemetry from the workers' persisted tail-logs (`telemetry.pull` type `logs`). `metric=hashrate` reads pool stats-history (H/s, the unit the pool contracts declare; all pools summed by default; pass `deviceId` for one pool). `metric=site-hashrate` reads the miners' own snap tail-logs summed across all miners (MH/s; pass `deviceId` for one miner). `metric=power` reads site powermeter series (all meters summed by default; pass `deviceId` for one meter). `metric=temperature` reads sensor tail-logs, averaged by default; this example ships no sensor Worker, so it returns empty unless one is added. Defaults to the last hour.

routes.description: Dispatches the `setupPools` capability command to a single miner through Kernel. Pools from the request body take precedence; with no body the site-wide default from `config/site.deploy.json` (`worker.pools`) is applied. The miner reboots to pick up the new pools, so expect it to drop offline briefly.
constraints: At most 3 pools per miner (whatsminer API limit).
Each pool needs url and worker_name; appendId=false disables the per-device worker-name suffix.
